prompts.concept:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production visual reference for a Blender-authored modular Roblox Backrooms Level 1 facelift.
Primary request: a high quality architectural contact sheet with six large cinematic panels of THE SAME cohesive yellow Backrooms environment: (1) empty straight office corridor, (2) L corner, (3) T intersection, (4) open low-ceiling column room, (5) cluttered maintenance alcove with grey electrical relay cabinet and wall lever, (6) a lonely elevator vestibule. Faithful classic yellow Backrooms liminal maze, uncanny and deserted, not a new theme.
Materials: faded pale mustard wallpaper with subtle tiny vertical geometric pattern and dark damp staining at skirting, beige yellow matted loop-pile carpet with clearly visible fibre and compressed foot traffic lanes, old acoustic ceiling tiles in a metal T-grid, recessed fluorescent twin-tube fixtures with aged diffusers, off-white skirting with bevels. Small worn tan office chair and grey filing cabinet visible only in alcove, a few brown cardboard cartons, black rubber electrical cable. All props share realistic restrained aged office material language.
Composition: six equally sized panels, room views from human eye height with grounded proportions and connected open passages, believable kit seams and distinct silhouettes. Strong environmental geometry reference, no people or entity, no text. Show well-lit nearest surfaces so modelling details are legible, with darker areas deeper into rooms.
Lighting: overhead sickly warm fluorescent, soft pool lights, dim falloff and isolated unlit bays, contact shadows, restrained photographic realism, no bloom wash. Carpet should read tactile through PBR detail rather than shiny plastic. No neon, sci-fi, glossy floor, floating lights, enormous ceiling heights, outdoor elements, labels, watermark.
prompts.carpet:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: seamless square BASE COLOR texture for Blender and Roblox PBR carpet, derived from the yellow Backrooms room reference.
Primary request: generate one perfectly flat orthographic macro material scan of aged beige mustard yellow loop pile office carpet, densely packed fine looped fibres, irregular tan ochre brown yarn flecks, subtly flattened wear, very slight low contrast mottling, physically believable tactile fabric. Edge-to-edge material only, seamlessly repeatable on both axes, no border or perspective. Colour fairly subdued warm grey beige ochre, avoid intense yellow.
Lighting: completely uniform shadowless diffuse light, zero baked directional shading, no specular highlight, no ambient occlusion, no vignette.
Constraints: no objects, room, carpet tile seams, labels or watermark. This is albedo only, tiny fibre detail should read at a metre scale, no big stains or repeated motifs.
prompts.wallpaper:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one square seamless base-color PBR wallpaper scan for Blender/Roblox, consistent with classic yellow Backrooms contact sheet.
Primary request: faded warm pale mustard beige office wallpaper, very small sparse brown vertical double-chevron botanical geometric motifs repeating in an orderly delicate wallpaper pattern. Old fibrous paper grain and faint low contrast humidity mottling, a modest inexpensive 1970s office finish. Design scale: repeat covers about 1 metre wall surface with many small motifs.
Composition: perfectly orthographic flat scan, edge-to-edge wallpaper only, seam-free repeat in both directions, no skirting or wall seams, no room or perspective, no text. Base colour only under uniform neutral shadowless diffuse light. Do not bake any lighting, highlights, shadows, dark edges or large stains. No high contrast or vibrant yellow.
prompts.ceiling:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square seamless albedo material scan for aged acoustic ceiling tile PBR in Blender and Roblox.
Primary request: uniform old warm ivory cream mineral-fibre acoustic ceiling tile material, tiny sparse dark pinholes and shallow random porous fibres, dry chalky slightly yellowed finish, very subtle low contrast irregular mottling. Entire image is the texture of ONE tile interior, no tile borders or metal grid.
Composition: orthographic top-down scan, perfectly flat, edge-to-edge seamless repeating material on both axes. Uniform neutral diffuse light with zero shading, shadows, highlights or vignette. No room, object, text, big cracks, pronounced spots or diagonal grain. Material base colour only.
